If 750 calories are burnt by jogging 6 km, how many calories were burnt in the given week
solution:
**Formula Used:**

Total distance jogged in the week = Sum of distances jogged on each day

Calories burnt per km = Total calories burnt / Total distance jogged

Total calories burnt in the week = Total distance jogged in the week × Calories burnt per km
